description: This file defines the 'FileManager' class within the OpenCart Admin Controller's Common namespace. It provides methods for managing files and directories, including listing, uploading, and browsing through file structures, specifically for the admin interface of OpenCart.

classes.name: FileManager
classes.description: Controller class that handles file management operations such as listing directories, uploading files, and navigating through the directory structure in the admin panel.

classes.name: FileManager
classes.description: Controller class that handles file management operations such as listing directories, uploading files, creating new directories, and deleting files/directories within the OpenCart admin interface.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Renders the main file manager interface, setting up the necessary data and loading the view.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Provides a listing of directories and files within a specified directory, supporting pagination, filtering, and navigation links.

methods.name: upload
methods.description: Handles the uploading of files to the server, including permission checks and filename sanitization.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Renders the main file manager interface for the admin panel, setting up necessary data, permissions, and view.

methods.name: folder

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes specified files or directories recursively, with permission validation and proper cleanup.
